warnings: Axes: x = numbered grids 1-8 (3.00/1.00/2.00/2.00/2.00/1.00/3.00 = 14.00); y = Thai-lettered rows printed top-to-bottom ช, ฉ, จ, ง, ค, ข, ก (3.50/2.50/2.20/2.80/4.00/2.00 = 17.00). Origin = top-left row ช on grid 1 (same convention as houses 53/65).

The floor-1 plan carries a second y chain (จ +2.00 +2.00 +1.00 +1.50 +2.50 = ข) whose ticks 8.00, 10.00 and 12.50 are not grid rows — most floor beams sit on them, not on ง/ค. ง (8.20) and จ' (8.00) are 0.20 apart and both printed.
Two C1 columns near rows ข-ก between grids 6 and 8 are placed 'ระยะตามแบบสถาปัตย์' (per the architectural drawings) with no dimension on the S sheets — not given grid lines here.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget) — x/y hold the S-sheet ticks only.
